name: Sequence
description:
# Sequence

[Wiki Page](https://wiki.roll20.net/Script:Sequence)

A general-purpose keyframe animation engine for Roll20 tokens. Record token movements and attribute changes in real time, then play them back on any token with smooth interpolation, easing, looping, speed control, and expression-driven values.

## Features

- **Record** -- Move a token and change its attributes while Sequence captures each change as a timestamped keyframe.
- **Playback** -- Replay recordings on any token with smooth lerp interpolation between keyframes.
- **Easing** -- Per-attribute easing curves: `linear`, `sine`, `quad`, `cubic`, `expo`, `circle`, `power(n)`, `bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2)` (CSS cubic-bezier). Ease-in, ease-out, and ease-in-out all supported.
- **Expressions** -- Keyframe values can be expressions: `+rand(-140,140)`, `=clamp(prev+50,orig-200,orig+200)`, `=color.hsl(rand(0,360),100,50)`.
- **String Animation** -- Animate text attributes (name, tooltip) with Levenshtein-based interpolation. Type-out effects with easing.
- **Unit Functions** -- `cell(n)` for grid cells, `unit(n)` for map-scale distance, `get("attr")` to reference other attributes.
- **Looping** -- Loop indefinitely or N times, with `reset` (snap back) or `accumulate` (each cycle builds on the last) modes.
- **Built-in Examples** -- 8 ready-to-use animations: spin, hover, pulse, orbit, shake, torch-flicker, rgb-cycle, boss-phase-2. Generate via `!sequence example`.
- **UDL Lighting** -- Animate both legacy and Updated Dynamic Lighting properties.
- **Portable** -- Recordings stored in `[Sequence] name` handouts. Copy a handout to another campaign to transfer an animation.
- **Extensible** -- External scripts can register custom attributes, expression functions, constants, and easing curves.

## Quick Start

1. Type `!sequence example` to see built-in animations, then click Generate and Play
2. Or: select a token and type `!sequence record my-animation`
3. Move the token and change its attributes
4. Type `!sequence stop` -- the recording saves automatically
5. Select any token and type `!sequence play my-animation`

## Commands

`!sequence record [name] [--attrs a,b,...]` -- Start recording selected token(s)

`!sequence stop` -- Stop and save recording

`!sequence pause` / `!sequence resume` -- Pause/resume recording

`!sequence play <name> [--loop] [--loops n] [--speed x] [--reverse] [--offset ms] [--only a,b] [--exclude a,b]` -- Play a recording

`!sequence preview <name>` -- Play and auto-revert when finished

`!sequence stop-play` / `!sequence pause-play` / `!sequence resume-play` -- Control playback

`!sequence example [search]` -- List built-in examples with Play/Loop buttons

`!sequence example! <name>` -- Generate an example recording handout

`!sequence list` -- List all recordings

`!sequence edit <name>` -- Open the recording handout

`!sequence delete <name>` -- Delete a recording

`!sequence add-attribute <name> <attr>` -- Add an attribute column

`!sequence remove-attribute <name> <attr>` -- Remove an attribute column

`!sequence add-row <name> <time>` -- Add a blank keyframe row

`!sequence sort <name>` -- Sort keyframes by time

`!sequence refresh <name>` -- Regenerate handout from cache

`!sequence man [topic]` -- In-game help. Topics: `attr`, `func`, `vars`, `easing`, or any name

`!sequence debug` -- Show active sessions

`!sequence dump-html <name>` -- Print raw handout HTML to the API console

`!sequence gen-dev-docs` -- Generate the extension developer guide in your journal

## Attributes

All standard graphic token properties are supported: `left`, `top`, `rotation`, `width`, `height`, `bar1_value`-`bar3_value`, auras, lighting (legacy + UDL), colors, strings (`name`, `tooltip`), booleans, and more. Run `!sequence man attr` in chat for the full list.

## Extension API

Other scripts can extend Sequence by listening for the `!sequence-ready` chat signal and calling:

`Sequence.registerAttribute` / `Sequence.registerAttributeGroup` / `Sequence.registerValueFunction` / `Sequence.registerTimingFunction` / `Sequence.registerPlaybackConstant` / `Sequence.registerEasing` / `Sequence.registerExample` / `Sequence.generateExtensionHandout`

Run `!sequence gen-dev-docs` to generate the full extension developer guide.

**v1.1.0 - New features:**
- ScriptKit integration: help, whatsnew, gen-help handout generation

Commands:
- `!sequence record [name] [--attrs a,b,...] [obj_id...]` -- Start recording on selected/listed tokens
- `!sequence stop [obj_id...]` -- Stop recording (auto-saves if name was given)
- `!sequence pause [obj_id...]` -- Pause recording without discarding keyframes
- `!sequence resume [obj_id...]` -- Resume a paused recording
- `!sequence save <name> [--force] [obj_id...]` -- Save unnamed recording under <name>
- `!sequence play <name> [flags] [obj_id...]` -- Play a recording on selected/listed tokens
- `!sequence preview <name> [flags] [obj_id...]` -- Play and auto-revert when finished
- `!sequence stop-play [obj_id...]` -- Stop playback on selected/listed tokens
- `!sequence pause-play [obj_id...]` -- Pause active playback
- `!sequence resume-play [obj_id...]` -- Resume paused playback
- `!sequence playback-menu [obj_id...]` -- Show playback controls for active playback
- `!sequence list` -- List all saved recordings
- `!sequence edit <name>` -- Open the recording handout editor
- `!sequence delete <name> [--force]` -- Delete a recording
- `!sequence add-attribute <name> <attr>` -- Add an attribute column to a recording
- `!sequence remove-attribute <name> <attr>` -- Remove an attribute column from a recording
- `!sequence add-row <name> <time_ms>` -- Add blank keyframe row at given time
- `!sequence add-command <name> <time_ms> <chat-command>` -- Add command keyframe to saved recording
- `!sequence command <chat-command> [obj_id...]` -- Insert command keyframe during active recording
- `!sequence sort <name>` -- Re-parse and sort keyframes by time
- `!sequence set-easing <name> <time_ms> <attr> <easing>` -- Set easing for a keyframe
- `!sequence set-type <name> <time_ms> <type>` -- Set keyframe type
- `!sequence refresh <name>` -- Regenerate handout from parsed cache
- `!sequence debug` -- Show active recording/playback sessions
- `!sequence dump-html <name>` -- Print raw handout HTML to API console

useroptions.name: Playback FPS
useroptions.description: Frames per second for animation playback. Higher values are smoother but increase API load. 30 is recommended for most games; try 10-15 if you experience performance issues.
